title: POP-Q stage III-IV prolapse
criterion_text: 根据盆腔器官脱垂分度（POP-Q）诊断为III-IV度的患者

title: prostate adverse pathology or PSA threshold
clinical_logic: pT3a-4 OR R1 OR pN1 OR GS>=8 OR PSA>0.1

title: labs not above twice ULN
clinical_logic: AST<=2xULN AND ALT<=2xULN AND BUN<=2xULN AND Cr<=2xULN
service_query: Observation _profile then aggregate all four codes with value<=2*high
known_risk: original frozen polarity and ANY logic were reversed

title: age >=50 with confirmed head-face herpes zoster
criterion_text: 年龄≥50岁诊断明确的头面部带状疱疹患者
clinical_logic: age>=50 AND confirmed zoster AND linked head/face site

title: active target infectious/connective-tissue disease
criterion_text: 甲肝、乙肝、艾滋病、结核等传染性疾病或结缔组织病处于活动期者

title: postoperative invasive mechanical ventilation
criterion_text: 术后需要有创机械通气
clinical_logic: surgery AND invasive ventilation AND postoperative relation
known_risk: parent surgery must ship in bundle

title: adequate hepatic and renal function
criterion_text: 无明显肝肾功能异常（Scr<178μmol/L；BUN<9mmol/L；ALT和AST无明显升高）
clinical_logic: Scr<178 AND BUN<9 AND ALT<=ULN AND AST<=ULN
service_query: aggregate latest four profile observations and thresholds
known_risk: service uses fixed ALT/AST thresholds while clinical IR uses explicit ULN

title: intracranial hypertension or consciousness impairment
known_risk: no source evidence chooses CURRENT_ACTIVE versus EVER_PRESENT

title: smoking or cessation under two years
severe diarrhea or constipation
clinical_logic: (diarrhea OR constipation) AND severe AND not resolved

known_risk: bare history without usable time remains unknown

title: first irinotecan-containing chemotherapy administration
criterion_text: 首次应用包含伊立替康的化疗方案治疗
clinical_logic: actual first irinotecan administration and not planned/prior

title: prior chemotherapy at outside hospital
